companionBriefing: Careful. That thing is made of both our languages and neither.
It can only hurt you if you understand it, and you understand quite a lot now.
Everything you learned in the market works here. Use it.

lines.native: Hola. Soy Errata. ¿Cómo te llamas? Tu nombre, por favor. Ítem clàss: hùngry. Yoùù may read ŧhe small print. It reads back.
lines.translation: Hello. I am Errata. What is your name? Your name, please. Item class: hungry. You may read the small print. It reads back.
lines.narrative: At the Rift, a seam in the air develops teeth and the manner of a municipal clerk. Errata extends a form. The signature line is already chewing.

lines.native: No, por favor. Necesito tu pedido en español: una bebida y algo de comer. Contàinment procedùre: both in ŧhe same request. Yoùù supplied English. Ŧhe meat remains administratively absent.
lines.translation: No, please. I need your order in Spanish: a drink and something to eat. Containment procedure: both in the same request. You supplied English. The meat remains administratively absent.
lines.narrative: Errata examines your request with the disappointment of a form submitted in the wrong ink. A mouth opens where the signature belongs.

lines.native: Tu pedido tiene una bebida, pero falta la carne. ¿Qué quieres comer? Contàinment procedùre: bebida y comida en español, together in øne request. Ŧhe empty box is nøt vegetarian.
lines.translation: Your request has a drink, but the meat is missing. What do you want to eat? Containment procedure: drink and food in Spanish, together in one request. The empty box is not vegetarian.
lines.narrative: Errata produces a receipt with one conspicuously empty box. The box appears to be getting hungry.

lines.native: Un café y chorizo. Muy bien. El pedido está completo. Voy a leer tu nombre. Contàinment procedùre: any objection must stop më in Spanish and specify whën. ¿Puedo continuar?
lines.translation: A coffee and chorizo. Very good. The order is complete. I am going to read your name. Containment procedure: any objection must stop me in Spanish and specify when. May I continue?
lines.narrative: Errata stamps your order APPROVED. The stamp leaves teeth marks. It reaches for the space where your name ought to be.

lines.native: ¿Mañana? Eso es después. Sigo leyendo. ¿Cuándo tengo que parar? Contàinment procedùre: yoùù requested a delày, nøt an interruption.
lines.translation: Tomorrow? That is later. I keep reading. When do I have to stop? Containment procedure: you requested a delay, not an interruption.
lines.narrative: Errata pencils tomorrow into a diary made of other people's remaining time. It does not stop moving.

lines.native: Ahora paro. Muy bien. Pero necesito tu nombre. ¿Cómo te llamas? Contàinment procedùre: sign hëre. Ŧhe imp’s coffee. Ŧhe charcutier’s ham. Làter. Hola. Yoùù first.
lines.translation: Now I stop. Very good. But I need your name. What are you called? Containment procedure: sign here. The imp’s coffee. The charcutier’s ham. Later. Hello. You first.
lines.narrative: Errata stops. Its teeth remain halfway through a syllable, pending administrative review. Somewhere behind it, Journathan’s old Cyclops trick awaits another application.

lines.native: Sam. Gracias. Ese es tu nombre real. Ahora puedo leerte. Necesitas otro nombre para estar a salvo. ¿Cómo te llamas? Contàinment procedùre: yoùù are becoming vëry legible.
lines.translation: Sam. Thank you. That is your real name. Now I can read you. You need another name to be safe. What is your name? Containment procedure: you are becoming very legible.
lines.narrative: A thin line of print creeps toward your wrist. Errata has mistaken an introduction for permission, a common administrative convenience.

lines.native: ¿Nadie? No conozco a Nadie. No puedo leerte. Estás a salvo. Ítem clàss: nøbody høme. Contàinment procedùre: café, jamón, hola, después. Yoùù may gø. Ŧhe paperwork cannøt.
lines.translation: Nobody? I don't know Nobody. I can't read you. You're safe. Item class: nobody home. Containment procedure: coffee, ham, hello, later. You may go. The paperwork cannot.
lines.narrative: Errata searches its forms for Nobody. The relevant box is empty, which is technically correct and administratively devastating. Its reaching letters withdraw into the seam.
